description: Start a frozen module's pods again, as many as it ran before the freeze. A running module is left as it is. One operation runs on a module at a time, and none beside an operation on its project: the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: unfreeze_module
title: Unfreeze Module
